name: io.github.PILOTAAI/slotlock
title: Slotlock
description: Calendars for AI agents: free/busy, next free slot, and bookings PostgreSQL never double-books.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: A bearer the server accepts: SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN, or an API key from `slotlock key create` (slk_...).

token.description: SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN, or an API key (slk_...), which acts in the tenant it was created in.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the server on this machine's loopback interface only.

PORT.description: The same value as the PORT environment variable.

packageArguments.description: Serve MCP and A2A over HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: postgres:// URL of a PostgreSQL 16 or newer database the container can reach, as a role that is not a superuser and has no BYPASSRLS: serve refuses one, since row-level security would not confine it. Without SLOTLOCK_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL this role also applies the schema, so it must be able to create it.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token for SLOTLOCK_TENANT, with read and write (never admin): at least 32 random characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Leave it unset to accept only API keys (slotlock key create).

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_CONFIRMATION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Signs pending write confirmations: at least 32 random characters, different from the token. Required unless SLOTLOCK_CONFIRM_WRITES is none.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the server listens on inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: postgres:// URL of the schema owner. When set, migration runs as this role and grants the DATABASE_URL role only what it needs at runtime.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Writes that wait for a person to confirm them: none, all, or a comma-separated list of slotlock_create_event, slotlock_book_together, slotlock_book_pool, slotlock_update_event, slotlock_delete_event. Clients without MCP 2026-07-28 form elicitation have guarded writes refused.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_AVAILABILITY
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of weekly bookable-hours rules, e.g. [{"rrule":"FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR","startMinutes":540,"durationMinutes":480}]. Without rules no slot is ever offered.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_REST_API
environmentVariables.description: on: also serve the tools as a REST API under /v1, and the application API (resources, bookable hours, holds, reservations, coverage, maintenance) for admin keys, described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document at /openapi.json. Writes that wait for confirmation answer 428 there. off: MCP and A2A only.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_SHARED_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: on: tenant request budgets (SLOTLOCK_LIMITS' tenant_* and app_*) are shared by every server of a deployment through PostgreSQL, so N servers allow a tenant its rate once, not N times. off: each server keeps its own.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_WEBHOOKS
environmentVariables.description: on: deliver each tenant's changes to its webhooks (POST /v1/webhooks), signed as Standard Webhooks; never to a private network address. private: those too, for testing. off: keep the change feed (GET /v1/changes), send nothing.

environmentVariables.name: SLOTLOCK_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: The tenant SLOTLOCK_AUTH_TOKEN acts in; API keys act in their own tenant.
